components.css: .ds-business-review-summary { border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; padding: 16px; color: #3f4174; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-business-review-summary header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-business-review-summary h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-business-review-summary header p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: hsl(233 14% 46%); font-size: 14px; } .ds-business-review-summary__badge { flex: none; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(59 130 246 / 0.1); padding: 5px 12px; color: #1d4ed8; font-size: 12px; } .ds-business-review-summary dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px 24px; margin: 20px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 16px; } .ds-business-review-summary dt { color: hsl(233 14% 46%); font-size: 14px; } .ds-business-review-summary dd { margin: 4px 0 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 14px; } .ds-business-review-summary__copy { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-business-review-summary__note { margin: 8px 0 0; color: hsl(233 14% 46%); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; } @media (max-width: 639px) { .ds-business-review-summary dl { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

narrative.overview: Trustworthy, precise and calm controls for local protection decisions.

rules.name: Explicit scope
rules.body: Describe whether a choice affects listed tools or the whole connector.

rules.name: Native review boundary
rules.body: Keep the native business review display-only: show saved facts and truthful unavailable or recovery status without claiming provider-account verification or execution.

dos: Keep tool choices visible and keyboard accessible.
Keep the Inbox mobile scroll pane above fixed bottom navigation.
donts: Do not imply that an observed catalog is a complete remote inventory.
Do not add a Saved request kicker or imply connected decision or execution surfaces to the native business review.
